venues.name: M&T Bank Stadium

events.enthusiasm: Purple vs burgundy under the lights — the Ravens–Commanders rivalry has real heat now. Preseason finale still draws a loud crowd; look for starters to get a series or two and the tailgates to treat it like a dress rehearsal for September.

Home opener. First real regular-season night in the building. Expect full purple, early-arriving tailgates, and the usual downtown energy that makes M&T one of the better home-field environments in the league when the Ravens are rolling.

venues.history: Ravens home since 1998. Downtown stadium with direct harbor access, Purple Friday energy, and one of the loudest regular-season crowds in the AFC North. Tailgates spill into the surrounding lots and Federal Hill bars.
venues.people_love: This is Baltimore football culture in full. The stadium sits right on the Inner Harbor, so you can walk from a pregame crab cake to the turns.
